cover_headline: Teen Chess Master Md Imran Risks US Scholarship as Visa Deadline Closes In
facts: His approved F-1 visa was in the passport he lost in Bratislava in June 2026
He has tried every day for four months without securing a US visa appointment
His family has taken on Rs 40-50 lakh in loans over two years to fund his European playing circuit

end.headline: Teen Chess Master Md Imran Risks US Scholarship as Visa Deadline Closes In
end.line: The 17-year-old International Master must secure his visa before UTRGV's January 19, 2027 orientation or lose his full scholarship.
